title: Intra-warp inclusive scan via __shfl_up_sync (CUDA)
info: Real CUDA-C compiled by arena.cuda_c.CudaProgram, executed on arena.cuda_sim.GPU.
64 threads = 2 warps, single block; the scan must reset at each 32-lane warp boundary.
__shfl_up_sync must be the WHOLE right-hand side of its own assignment/initializer -- read it into its own variable, then conditionally add it in a separate statement.
